name: pl-pull_scp
title: A ChRIS plugin FS app that scp's data from a remote host
description: This plugin application is used to recursively copy data from a remote host into an analysis root node.

parameters.name: str_username
parameters.help: The username in the remote computer.

parameters.name: str_password
parameters.help: The <username>'s password in the remote computer.

parameters.name: str_hostname
parameters.help: The name of the remote computer.

parameters.name: str_sshPubKeyFile
parameters.help: The ssh public key file to use.

parameters.name: str_filepath
parameters.help: The location in the remote computer to pull.
